prompt: Faithfully recreate only the Japanese first-conversation introduction panel shown in the primary native preview, using an exact 390x380 white canvas. The native Japanese preview controls all final copy, color, geometry and spacing. At top left, place the pale-mint circular avatar with the dark green 「山」 glyph, approximately x=16,y=13,size=80px. Preserve the two-line empty-state message 「山田さんとの会話がここから始まります。」 and 「まずは短い挨拶を送ってみましょう。」 in muted gray. Then place the small mint-backed green shared-group icon and exact label 「共通のグループ 1件」. At the bottom left, preserve the forest-green pill button at x≈16,y≈330,width≈184,height≈32 with exact white text 「友だち申請を送る」. Keep the simple white canvas and native compact type. This screen contains no hyperlink: the friend-request control is a button, with white button text, not blue link text. The source screenshot is semantic context only; do not copy its person photo, English name/handle/message, source brand icon or any extra copy. Do not add shadows, borders, links or frames.
